I'm checking whether "hexosaminidase A deficiency and pseudodeficiency" could be a composite mention, since the span pairs a specific condition with a non-disease state. The title as a whole doesn't read as one clean disease mention, so I'm weighing whether the disease part alone should count.

I'm now leaning toward CompositeMention for the title span, since it seems to cover both "hexosaminidase A deficiency" and "pseudodeficiency" as two contiguous conditions. The second part isn't clearly a disease, though, so I'm still unsure whether the composite label holds.

I'm now weighing the remaining candidates against the annotation rules, starting with "pseudodeficient" as a possible mention alongside the title span. For the Tay-Sachs abbreviations, "TSD" in the parenthetical counts as a synonymous mention to annotate separately, while the uses as "TSD carriers," "TSD heterozygotes," and "TSD patient" are modifiers.

I'm settling on pseudodeficiency as a benign allele state rather than a disease, so it doesn't get annotated as a mention. It's a description of an allele, and the paper frames it as clinically benign.
